title: Personal Loans Refinance Desk Rules: Eligibility of the Loan Being Refinanced and Payoff at Funding
content:
## Rules in force

An existing borrower may replace an active Larkspur Personal Loans loan with a new Larkspur loan (loan purpose refinance of an existing loan, naming the old loan as the loan refinanced) whose proceeds pay the old loan off. The loan being refinanced must be in active status. The application is taken only when the current date is at least the refinance minimum months after the funding date of the loan being refinanced. Months are counted as whole calendar months from the funding date, and when the later month has no matching day the last day of that month is used. The loan being refinanced has an amount past due of 0.00, no hardship plan on it is in requested, offered or active status, and its most recent consecutive on-time installments number at least the refinance minimum of its grade. The months and on-time counts are taken from the grade of the loan being refinanced.

At funding, one refinance payoff transfer disbursement line pays exactly that quote's payoff amount to the old loan, which posts there as a payoff payment through internal transfer and closes the old loan as refinanced; any remainder goes to the borrower as a borrower deposit. Only one refinance application per old loan may be open at a time. AutoPay on the old loan does not carry over; the borrower enrolls the new loan separately.

Consecutive on-time installments are counted backwards from the latest installment due on or before today: each installment paid in full no later than the end of its late-fee grace period, with no late fee charged for it, extends the run; an installment deferred under a hardship plan is skipped.

## Clause no longer in force as worded

The clause below is no longer in force as worded:

> The new loan is underwritten, priced and capped like any new loan (its own grade, the reduced refinance origination fee, the combined principal cap without the old loan's principal), and its net proceeds must cover the payoff amount of a refinance-purpose payoff quote good through the expected funding date; otherwise the application is approved only if the borrower raises the requested amount within the grade's limits.

For a refinance application whose amount financed is sized from the payoff it retires, the refinance origination fee is the one that sizing sets; the new loan is otherwise underwritten, priced and capped like any new loan (its own grade, the combined principal cap without the old loan's principal), its net proceeds must cover the payoff amount of a refinance-purpose payoff quote good through the expected funding date, and otherwise the application is approved only if the borrower raises the requested amount within the grade's limits.

## Seasoning (hypothetical funding dates, 6-month minimum)

| Funded | Earliest date the application is taken |
|---|---|
| 15 January | 15 July |
| 31 August | 28 February (29 February in a leap year) |

On 14 July a loan funded 15 January has 5 whole months and the application is not taken; on 15 July it has 6.

## Standing of the loan being refinanced

| Fact on the records | Application taken |
|---|---|
| any amount past due | no |
| hardship plan on it requested, offered or active | no |
| consecutive on-time installments below its grade's refinance minimum | no |
